headlines.headline: NCAA WINS STAY BLOCKING '5-IN-5' ELIGIBILITY RULING, PULLING PREVIOUSLY CLEARED PLAYERS BACK OUT OF ACTION
headlines.detail: A federal judge in Ohio granted the NCAA a stay of a prior injunction in the ongoing 5-in-5 eligibility litigation, pulling previously cleared players back out of games and the transfer portal while the case proceeds.

headlines.headline: RUSSELL WESTBROOK RETIRES AFTER 18-YEAR CAREER, FINISHES FIFTH ALL-TIME IN ASSISTS
headlines.detail: Westbrook closes his career with 10,351 assists, fifth-most in NBA history. Free agency buzz continues around LeBron James' next destination and the Lakers' ownership sale to Mark Walter amid a federal probe.

headlines.headline: SAINTS' FIRST-ROUND WR JORDYN TYSON OUT TWO MONTHS WITH TRAINING-CAMP HAMSTRING INJURY
headlines.detail: New Orleans' first-round pick is expected to miss roughly two months. Giants WR Malik Nabers cleared a full-speed practice milestone Monday in his return from a torn ACL.

headlines.headline: MULTIPLE PROGRAMS CROSS $40 MILLION ROSTER SPENDING THRESHOLD AS FALL CAMPS WIND DOWN
headlines.detail: A CBS Sports poll of industry insiders found several programs have crossed the $40 million mark for 2026 roster spending as the Big Ten and Big 12 seasons open Aug. 29.
